label: e01-pr87
note: 190k/200k LG-limited (old harness: loadgen processes shared one CPU set); re-run as e01b

label: e02-new
what: new design: epoll I/O, own PG client, batched lanes, own bcrypt; first build
note: warm-up showed PG 4.4 ms/req: currval() in WHERE seq-scanned articles after each insert; fixed with a scalar subquery

label: e03-hubs
what: shared followee probes for feed counts (HUB_COUNT) and feed page bounds (FEED_BOUND)
note: first run used the pre-fix build, discarded

label: e04-tagprobe
what: global/tag counts proved by a 1,000th row (EXISTS OFFSET 999) instead of an aggregate over 1,000 rows
note: side cluster: 200 tag counts 15.3 ms -> 10.1 ms; 197/197 dev and full seed

label: e05-bcfill
what: bcrypt waits up to 250 ms for 6 lanes (BCRYPT_FILL 6)

label: e06-leader
what: lane leader: one idle thread sleeps out the clock, the rest block untimed (no timed Monitor.Wait)
note: timed waits spun before blocking; write threads 18% of app CPU at 50k

label: e07-wans
what: write answers (favorites, follows) via the read lane after commit

label: e08-batch
what: SCHED_BATCH for own threads; usleep instead of Thread.Sleep(TimeSpan) for the clock

label: e09-sets
what: article authors, favorite counts, tags as id-ordered ANY lookups; follows flag = viewer's followee list checked in app

label: e10-side
what: second read lane and 3 connections for comments, profiles, users, logins
note: search: 100k 101.8 us/req, 200k pass 113.6; crashed (Out of memory, SIGABRT) at 300k after the 400k overload probe

label: e12-saop
what: bounded feeds from one SAOP index scan (author_id = ANY AND id >= bound)

label: e13-hmac
what: one IncrementalHash HMAC context per thread for JWT
note: HMACSHA256.HashData set up an OpenSSL context per call

label: e14-recv
what: recv/send with MSG_NOSIGNAL on client sockets

label: e15-over
what: overload defenses: per-event try/with, spare fd at EMFILE, 503 past 150k queued, unhandled logging

label: e17-fl
what: each feed viewer's follows read once (fl CTE) and reused for hubs, bounds, page, count, flags
note: real batches same rows; buffers 16,208 -> 12,069 fresh, 19,387 -> 14,095 aged follows
